findings.claim: The auth-proof test fails instead of skipping when required issuer/audience env vars are absent.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion 5 says the test must "skip (does not fail) when keys/env are absent" and also assert `FLINT_GATE_ISSUER`/`FLINT_GATE_AUDIENCE`; the test only gates on `FLINT_GATE_JWKS_URL` and `FLINT_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` at lines 38-45, then unconditionally asserts issuer/audience at lines 55-66.
findings.suggested_fix: Include `FLINT_GATE_ISSUER` and `FLINT_GATE_AUDIENCE` in the initial env-gated prerequisite check and return/skip when either is absent.

findings.claim: The auth-proof test does not authenticate a protected route as required; it only calls the auth helper directly.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion 5 requires "the real Sansaba `service_role` key authenticates a protected route and lands `role = \"service_role\"` in `RlsContext`"; the test invokes `fdb_auth::rls_from_bearer(&service_key)` directly at lines 70-72 and never exercises any gateway route.
findings.suggested_fix: Start the relevant fdb-gateway route/service in the integration test and send requests with `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, asserting the protected route accepts service_role and resolves the expected role.

findings.claim: Migration 0015 is not verbatim from FFS-001 §5 because it adds an extra all-access RLS policy for `flint_provisioner`.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion 1 requires `migrations/0015_flint_schema_provisioning.sql` be "verbatim from FFS-001 §5" and lists schema/table/index/role/grants; the diff adds `CREATE POLICY provision_ledger_provisioner_all ... TO flint_provisioner USING (true) WITH CHECK (true)` at lines 59-63 with an in-file note calling it a "Deviation from FFS-001 §5".
findings.suggested_fix: Either remove the policy to match the required FFS-001 §5 migration verbatim, or update the acceptance criteria/spec to explicitly authorize this deviation before shipping it.
